boundary.note: Foreign modules may import only Boundary public prefixes (ready / handoff / models / emit). Not Admit, not Documents, not Workforce.

documents.note: Foreign modules may import only Documents public evidence prefixes. Hub/storage/ORM internals stay private. Not Ready/Admit/Workforce lifecycle.

employment.note: Foreign modules may import only Employment public prefixes. Admit rulesets and ESO-5 internals stay private.

platform.note: Platform session/persistence/settings surface. Module runtimes may depend on these without counting as architectural debt; they are not spine business contracts.

recruitment.note: Foreign modules may import only these Recruitment prefixes. Edges into them are published contracts, not debt.

workforce.note: Foreign modules may import only Workforce public prefixes. Post-start state belongs here. Accepts Started Employee continuity; does not reconstruct Ready/RFE/Admit/evidence.
